mathematics.assertion_tested: Classical complements, exact centered Green compression and the sharpened entrywise bound 4B/N at every retained size; exact summed return clock and per-port 2B bound, including full and singleton sets.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q, exact Fractions and Gaussian elimination.
mathematics.conventions: P is row-walk nonnegative doubly stochastic; ||P-J||<=2/5 follows from a convex combination of two permutation matrices and J; no normality assumption.
inputs: One prescribed generally nonnormal rational doubly stochastic matrix for every N=3..8; every nonempty retained subset at each N.

bounds.retained_sets: all nonempty subsets, including all coordinates and singletons

non_claims: Does not certify all real matrix inputs by finite enumeration.
No quantum interference or BGS theorem.
